job.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI sprite for a fresh, cute, cozy animal rescue mobile game. Use image 1 for canvas and shape placement ONLY; image 2 is the actual game watercolor yard for style and palette reference ONLY. Do not draw any scenery. Fresh storybook watercolor illustration, soft rounded friendly forms, pastel mint and cream with peach accents, clean luminous colors, very subtle brush texture. No aging, no sepia, no bronze, no heavy dark outlines, no sharp corners, no plastic shine, no embossed bevels, no 3D rendering, no realistic shadows. PURE WHITE #ffffff background outside the object with a clean silhouette suitable for alpha extraction. No text or letters or numbers or logos or watermark. Render ONE round audio slider thumb viewed from the front, 76% of canvas diameter, centered. A perfectly circular milky cream biscuit-like disk with a thin soft mint contour and gentle watercolor shading, a single small pastel coral-pink animal pawprint in the center. Four round toes and one rounded paw pad, simple readable shape. Flat 2D, no perspective, no thick shadow, no outer square. The disk must be genuinely ROUND, not a rounded square.
job.negative: text, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, photorealistic, 3d render, glossy bevel, aged parchment, yellowed paper, distressed grain, brown outlines, dark olive, mustard, hard corners, metallic, heavy drop shadow, scenery, screenshot, extra objects
